A free-floating set of lines in a non-standard location

Text along the circumference of a circle

The text runs clockwise
Text along the radius of a circle
The text runs outside to inside (inwards)
The text runs inside to outside (outwards)

Position of locus is unrelated to previous item. The position of this locus is unrelated to the previous item, or not easily described by one of the following. This locator is always used for the first item on each page
Generally below the previous item. This is the most common case
At the start of the line below the previous item, but at the left margin, while the previous item was not
The locus is on the same line as the previous item but separated by some white space
Similar to AQ but along a circular line
Similar to AQ but the vertical alignment is not very good
This locus is to the right of, and above the previous locus
